story.title: OTP multi-factor login for web and mobile banking
story.description: Add a one-time passcode (OTP) step to customer login. After the password is accepted, the auth service sends a six-digit code by SMS through the notification service and only issues a session once the code is verified. Customers must have a verified mobile number and an MFA enrolment flag on their profile. Lock the login after five failed codes and record every attempt.
acceptance_criteria: Enrolled customers must enter a valid six-digit OTP after their password before a session is issued.
Codes expire after five minutes; five failed codes lock the login for 30 minutes.
The OTP SMS is sent through the notification service within 30 seconds.
Every OTP send, success and failure is recorded.
